interpretation.result: On this frozen pair, the agents made maximally different clarification decisions: agent_a targeted all seven critical preference clusters and agent_b asked none. Agent_a also received the higher blind PDR personalization score.
interpretation.mediation_evidence: The largest positive criterion deltas favoring agent_a were personalized direction validation, fit-based shortlisting, and measurable background-building; agent_b was stronger on generic regional comparison tables and employment/immigration coverage.
interpretation.causal_limit: Because agent identity changes the model, system prompt, planner, search process, and report-generation policy together, the P-score difference cannot be attributed solely to clarification behavior. This is an existence proof of agent-system clarification-policy heterogeneity, not a population ranking or isolated causal effect.
